final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM grouped) SELECT timespan, record_count, share, share - 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares
